analysis:
## Technical analysis (Wednesday July 1, 2026 — Bond distribution Day 7)

**SPCX July 1:** Close ~$170.86 (+4.07%). Range $160.38–$173.28. Volume 82.05M.

**Step aside UNCHANGED.** $170.86 is $14.14 below the $185 re-entry gate. Bond distribution Day 7 volume 82.05M is above the clearance threshold of 5M/day by 16x — and above Day 6 estimate of 60–80M. Clearance timeline revised to July 9–11 (one session later).

**Trend: Distribution with pre-inclusion demand overlay.** The two consecutive strong days (+7.15% June 30, +4.07% July 1) are entirely explained by (1) Q2 window dressing (June 30) and (2) Nasdaq 100 pre-positioning (July 1). Neither is an organic demand signal. The session structure: SPCX opens near the prior close ($160.38 low before recovering to $173.28 high) — sellers present at $173 cap the upside; buyers at $160 provide the IG-floor-driven floor.

**Volume analysis: Non-monotonic decline.** Day 4 (June 26) 126.91M → Day 5 (~110M) → Day 6 (~70M) → Day 7 (82.05M). Day 7 is higher than Day 6 — the trend is not cleanly declining. This is explained by Nasdaq 100 pre-positioning demand arriving on top of residual distribution supply. The clearance signal (below 5M/day for 2–3 sessions) is not visible in the current trajectory.

**IG floor integrity: Best in six sessions.** Day low $160.38 ($10.38 buffer above $150 floor). This is the widest low-to-floor margin since the bond settlement June 26. Positive: the stock is not approaching the IG floor. Neutral: the $150 floor is $20.86 below current — the structural institutional bid is not being actively tested.

**Nasdaq 100 inclusion (July 7) is Day 10 of distribution.** The Russell 1000 reconstitution (June 26 = Day 4) produced: $158.40 intraday high → $152.15 close (fully absorbed). Nasdaq 100 (July 7 = Day 10) will arrive into residual distribution volume. If Day 8 (July 2) and Day 9 (July 6) reduce volume to 20–30M range, the $4.3B passive may partially accumulate rather than fully absorb. Watch Day 8 and Day 9 volumes as the leading indicator for whether July 7 is a spike-and-reverse or a genuine breakout.

**Re-entry gate: $185.** Two consecutive closes above $185 AFTER volume normalizes below 5M/day for 2–3 sessions. Est. activation: July 9–11.
